1.2.5.1-r1.burton_quote: the manners do follow the temperature of the body

1.2.5.1-r2.burton_quote: is begotten by the distemperature of some inward part, innate, or left after some inflammation, or else included in the blood after an ague, or some other malignant disease
1.2.5.1-r2.translation: being too thick [shut up in the veins], or sluggish, it takes on a malignant quality.

1.2.5.1-r3.burton_quote: ague, or some other malignant disease
1.2.5.1-r3.translation: It is often evident that a man is made melancholic during a fever or after one. A hot distemperature, either innate or contracted from a fever.
